offering_description.value: AerSale sells and leases used commercial aircraft and engines and supplies reusable parts to airlines, cargo carriers and other aviation businesses. It acquires aircraft and engines, then resells or leases them or dismantles them for parts. It also repairs aircraft and components and develops and installs aircraft upgrades.

primary_products.value: used commercial aircraft; used aircraft engines; reusable aircraft and engine parts; cockpit vision systems; fuel tank safety and avionics retrofit kits

primary_services.value: aircraft and engine leasing; airframe maintenance and modification; component repair and overhaul; aircraft storage; aircraft and engine disassembly

customer_segment.value: B2B: passenger airlines, cargo carriers, aircraft lessors, equipment manufacturers and aviation repair shops; B2G: government aviation customers

end_markets.value: passenger aviation; air cargo; aircraft and engine leasing; aviation maintenance and repair; government aviation

revenue_model.value: product sales: used aircraft, engines, replacement parts and retrofit systems; rental or leasing: commercial aircraft and engines; service fees: component repairs, aircraft storage and disassembly; project or contract: heavy airframe maintenance and aircraft modification work
revenue_model.category: product sales; rental or leasing; service fees; project or contract

value_chain_position.value: distributor: acquires used aircraft, engines and parts and supplies operators, lessors and repair shops; asset operator: owns aircraft and engines for lease and operates maintenance and storage facilities for aircraft owners; service provider: maintains, modifies and dismantles aircraft and repairs components for operators and asset owners; OEM / manufacturer: develops aircraft retrofit systems for fleet operators
value_chain_position.category: distributor; asset operator; service provider; OEM / manufacturer

geography_served.value: global: U.S. operating facilities serving aviation customers in North America and overseas

specialization.value: related lines: aircraft and engine sales and leasing, parts supply, maintenance and aircraft upgrades

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales and leasing teams serving operators, lessors and maintenance providers; own locations: company-operated maintenance, component repair and aircraft storage facilities

regulatory_exposure.value: high: FAA repair station certification, airworthiness and parts traceability requirements, and approval of aircraft modifications
